entry.title: Cubanitos — Pack of 10
entry.eyebrow: Compact Cameroon Fuente with exact single taster
experienceTags: Occasion: Quick premium smoke, coffee break, afternoon smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Chestnut, baking spice, coffee bean, cedar and gentle natural sweetness are the expected centre of this compact Fuente Cameroon profile. Cubanitos use the same well-aged Dominican tobacco family as Arturo Fuente Gran Reserva in a 4½″ × 32 small-cigar format, with an African Cameroon wrapper over Dominican binder and filler. The narrow ring should keep the aromatic wrapper prominent while preserving a proper cigar-length session rather than dropping into club-cigar territory. Untasted in this catalogue, so Strength 6, Quality 7 and the flavour profile remain projections.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. Cigarworld currently lists the pack of 10 at A$154.80. The exact same Cubanito is also available singly for A$17.38, providing a low-commitment exact-line taster before buying the 10-pack.
practicalLines: Exact single taster available at A$17.38
